name: beamdesk-remote-system
description: BeamDesk - Professional, secure, WebRTC-powered remote desktop and support application

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
